items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I said it reminded me of that wonderful story of Fred Allen, the great American humorist

ctx.x: You didn't give me that little joke, that little line, about the head of a pin.

We were talking about greedy agents could be to get their 10 percent and in this particular case, this agent never stopped to think that we were human beings and he just wanted to get his commission so he booked us 28 days in a row, all over the Continent, no sleep.

And I said it reminded me of that wonderful story of Fred Allen, the great American humorist, he -- Fred Allen had a thing about agents, he called them the greedy ten-percenters and he said that you can take the smallest pinhead and inscribe the…
I think we have come to the end of this tape, so we'll turn it over.
